mina: Quick heads-up — smoketest for lumen9b-int4 (streaming chat) is hitting GPU OOMs on ~15% of runs after warmup. Seen during multi-turn with history and prefix caching.

mina: log snippet:

```
2026-03-23T14:12:05Z ERROR runtime: cudaOutOfMemory: out of memory when allocating 1.2GB
... allocator: slab-heap: free_slots fragmented 0.23 -> fail
trace: gen request id=abc123 max_new_tokens=256 stream=true
```

raj: Can you paste the serving config you used (microbatch, prefetch_window, max_new_tokens, batch_timeout)?

mina: Config we used for the canary:

```
model: lumen9b-int4
microbatch_size: 4
prefetch_window: 6
max_new_tokens: 256
streaming_chunk_size: 64
batch_timeout_ms: 25
soft_eviction: false
heap_reserve_mb: 0
```

sophie: My 2c: fragmentation looks classic for slab alloc + relatively large streaming chunks. Things to try (in order):
- drop microbatch_size -> 1 (avoid multi-request coalesce)
- reduce streaming_chunk_size -> 32 or 16
- enable slab alignment / compact on warmup if runtime supports (slab_align: true)
- add heap_reserve_mb: 512 for canary to give headroom
- reduce default max_new_tokens -> 128 (this cuts worst-case allocation)

raj: Also try warmup_zero_pad=true for the first request so the allocator reserves consistent-sized slabs and avoids small trailing free fragments. If we can, set soft_eviction=true with kv_eviction_threshold=0.7 so longer contexts get trimmed before OOM.

infra-bot: Canary update: applied runtime flag changes to pool ml-canary-7 (lumen9b-int4) at 2026-03-23T14:20:00Z. Monitoring redispatch and OOM metrics for 2 hours.

mina: Applied changes locally and to the canary: microbatch=1, streaming_chunk_size=32, slab_align=true, heap_reserve_mb=512, max_new_tokens=128. Kickoff 200-request ramp now.

mina: Initial 2h result: OOM rate dropped from ~15% -> 0.8% across the canary fleet. Latency p95 up ~3-4ms. No obvious quality regressions in smoke evals. :thumbsup:

eva: Nice. Please add this to the model onboarding doc + update the model-defaults table (max_new_tokens: 128 for lumen9b-int4). Also run the full eval suite (quality + long-context regression) before global rollout.

mina: Will open a PR with notes + a short playbook for slab fragmentation steps (what to toggle and metrics to watch). Follow-up: schedule full eval run overnight and report back tomorrow.
